title: Mission Program Binding
description: Binds one exact immutable Mission Revision to one exact Program / Blueprint identity. Created after blueprint_digest is computed and therefore outside the content domain that digest covers — a binding stored inside the Blueprint it hashes would be circular. Immutable: a new Program requires a new binding, and Mission supersession never rebinds an existing one. Authority: ADR-0026.

mission_revision.description: The exact revision admitted. A historical binding stays pinned to it after supersession.

mission_digest.description: Canonical SHA-256 hexadecimal, matching the shared evidence-reference digest format.

blueprint_digest.description: Digest of the exact Blueprint, computed before this binding exists.

bound_at.description: Explicit UTC timestamp. Format validation is enforced by the parser's FormatChecker.
